value_derivation.role: Penalize xy-axis base angular velocity using L2 squared kernel (Isaac Lab v2.3.1, reports/evidence/go2_reward_term_roles_20260917/isaaclab_envs_mdp_rewards.py:83): -w * (omega_x^2 + omega_y^2) in the body frame. It charges roll/pitch rate, not tilt and not a fall.
value_derivation.walk_margin: G-A033 walk margin +0.1359 -> +0.133 for the candidate rewards (go2_reward_mechanism.spec_margin, zone WALK, about eight times the stop zone's top +0.0155).
value_derivation.situations: spec_margin situations for the candidate rewards: climb +0.0351, sway +0.0372, push -0.0067. The sheet's sway cell got the direction wrong on this baseline before (G-A047, G-A048); it is recorded, not used as a prediction.
value_derivation.rule: -0.06 is +20 percent of the penalty, one third of G-A038's +60 percent step to -0.08. The width is limited because G-A038 collapsed the 10 cm climb; it is a design choice, not a measured safe value, and no data says -0.06 beats -0.055 or -0.065.
value_derivation.not_claimed: No score gain is estimated. G-A038's 18 rough side-step falls are more than G-A048's 16, so G-A038 does not say G-A048 will improve. Both G-A038 results come with a terrain-level difference at iteration 900 (G-A033 4.4937, G-A038 1.9499) that the reward change itself may have caused; the total results are observed but the direct mechanism is not separated.

preregistered.source: fact_rules_v1 with every G-A050 threshold unchanged AND the plan screening edition g3_guard_margin_v1 (tools/go2_screening_gate.py, workspace/training/quadruped/upload/plan/GO2_G_A051_PLAN_20260927.md section 3), both against the stored G-A033 arm. Combined locally by tools/verify_go2_basic_motion_harvest.py. There is no server gate. The hypothesis block and the reward-base comparison are separate readouts; the comparison only decides whether the result becomes a quantitative review candidate; it is not a final progress verdict.
preregistered.threshold_basis: Measured, not intended, and UNCHANGED from G-A050 (and G-A049, G-A048, G-A044, G-A043) on purpose for fact_rules_v1 - no adoption threshold moves after any result; the plan screening edition is g3_guard_margin_v1, preregistered before G-A050 (user decision G-D-G3-FIRST-20260927) and carried unchanged. tools/go2_eval_resolution.py (reports/runs/BASELINE_MARGIN.csv delta_resample_sd) gave per-scenario weighted-score standard deviations of G3 1.01823, G4 0.49816, G6 0.43098, G2 0.28229, G7 0.20179, G5 0.02802, G1 0.00000 (/70) and a total-difference sd of 1.26443/70. Each non-flat scenario may lose at most twice its own sd; flat G1/G2 use max_flat_scenario_proxy_drop 2x0.28229/10.5 = 0.054 and max_flat_case_survival_drop 2 robots of 32 - the limit that actually caught G-A043's combined_yaw_right at all three seeds. The group floors and the climbed-robot floors are G-A043's, recomputed from the same stored G-A033 records for the same groups. None of these limits carries training-seed noise: every training in the project used seed 42, so they are lower bounds.

target_group_roles.stairs: a scored group of fact_rules_v1, carried unchanged. Not this run's target: the plan protects the stairs. It is where G-A038 paid for the rough gain (10 cm posture falls 96 of 96), so the protection block's 10 cm and 15 cm checks are the first place a cost would show.
target_group_roles.rough: the plan's target. G-A048's G3 is 8.97736 of 14.0, bound by rough_lateral seed 202 survival 0.75; 10 of its 16 rough side-step falls are terminated only (reports/evidence/go2_next_lever_20260927/FALL_CHANNELS.csv).
target_group_roles.push: the disturbance guard. G-A048 lost 1 robot over the four push directions; a stiffer roll/pitch response could change how a shove is absorbed.

The reward change may itself change curriculum progress, so a difference here is part of the observed total result, not an independent confound; it means the direct mechanism is not separated.
required_records.climb_counts: REQUIRED RECORD, NOT A PLAN SCREENING CRITERION UNDER g3_guard_margin_v1 (the stairs are protected by posture falls and tracking only; this was a criterion in earlier editions): 10cm and 15cm pooled ge1 and ge2 each >= baseline; at least one of the four strictly increases. Existing fact_rules_v1 guards also apply. tools/go2_climb_count.py; both heights seed101/202/303.
required_records.stairs_forward_distance: REQUIRED RECORD, NOT A PLAN SCREENING CRITERION UNDER g3_guard_margin_v1 (the stairs are protected by posture falls and tracking only; this was a criterion in earlier editions): for each of stairs_10_down and stairs_15_down, median seed delta of projected_progress_m > 0. Baseline and candidate use the same evaluator/registry and iteration900.
required_records.stall_time_share: REQUIRED RECORD, NOT A PLAN SCREENING CRITERION UNDER g3_guard_margin_v1 (the stairs are protected by posture falls and tracking only; this was a criterion in earlier editions) (plan section 4 item 2). The share of time, before the first termination, in which the commanded-direction projected speed stays under 0.05 m/s for at least one continuous second, with the first 0.5 s and the terminal row excluded; null with a reason when the valid time is zero. Computed by tools/go2_stall_diagnostics.py for both arms with the same rule. The threshold is a design value, not a measured one. Both heights require median seed delta < 0 with simultaneous survival protection.
required_records.first_step_time: REQUIRED RECORD, NOT A CRITERION (plan section 4 item 3). The first timestamp at which the existing >=1 step climb rule fires, per robot, with non-arrivals recorded as null and censored=true. The mean over arrivals may not be reported as an improvement without the arrival rate beside it.
required_records.fall_channel_split: REQUIRED RECORD. The candidate rough_lateral and stairs falls are split into height only, tilt only, both, union only and terminated only by tools/go2_next_lever_evidence.py (reports/evidence/go2_next_lever_20260927/FALL_CHANNELS.csv), beside G-A048's. The change targets the terminated-only (rollover) share: 10 of G-A048's 16.
required_records.push_both_directions: REQUIRED RECORD AND PLAN SCREENING PROTECTION under g3_guard_margin_v1 (the four-direction rule in push_all_directions covers push_pos_x and push_neg_x). Earlier editions judged these two directions with zero allowed loss and survival-median checks (post_a042_push_v1); this run does not.
required_records.push_all_directions: REQUIRED RECORD AND PLAN SCREENING PROTECTION under g3_guard_margin_v1. For push_pos_x, push_neg_x, push_pos_y and push_neg_y SEPARATELY: pooled posture falls over the three seeds <= baseline + 3, and the per-seed median tracking delta >= -0.01 (1e-9 tolerance). There is no survival-median check. The allowed losses are post_a048_guard_margin_v1's, unchanged. Earlier verdicts keep their own editions (zero allowed loss under post_a043_push4_v1) and reproduce byte for byte.
required_records.g2_combined_yaw_both_directions: REQUIRED RECORD, NOT A NEW CRITERION (plan section 9-2). combined_yaw_left and combined_yaw_right are measured at all three seeds - which the full collection gives automatically - and filmed on both arms at seed 101. The judgement that catches a loss there is the EXISTING max_flat_case_survival_drop of 0.0625, which already fired on G-A043's three seeds. No new judgement code is written for G2; what changes is that the case can no longer be missed by the collection or absent from the video set.
required_records.reward_base_deltas: REQUIRED RECORD: tools/go2_reward_base_comparison.py prints candidate, G-A048 and the difference for the total, every axis, and posture falls, survival, tracking RMSE, speed and progress on the disclosed cases (both stair heights, combined turns both ways, all four pushes). These A048-relative protection deltas are disclosed, not judged: no A048-relative loss limit was preregistered, so a gain elsewhere can hide a specific A048 loss inside the total. They are read by a person at candidate review before anything is called progress.

preregistered.mechanism_readout: Three readouts, reported separately and never merged (workspace/training/quadruped/upload/plan/GO2_G_A051_PLAN_20260927.md section 3). ADOPTION: fact_rules_v1 plus g3_guard_margin_v1 against the stored G-A033; its passing value is QUANT_SUCCESS_VIDEO_REVIEW_PENDING, i.e. the quantitative conditions are met before video review - not an adoption PASS. HYPOTHESIS: preregistered.hypothesis read by tools/go2_dial_hypothesis.py. EFFECT: preregistered.reward_base_comparison read by tools/go2_reward_base_comparison.py against G-A048; its REVIEW_CANDIDATE is a quantitative review candidate, not a final progress verdict, because no A048-relative loss limits are preregistered for the protected cases. Meeting the G-A033 criteria while doing worse than G-A048 is reported as exactly that and never as tuning progress. A protection failure against G-A033, or rough side-step falls not reduced below 16, rejects the arm; no -0.055 / -0.065 follow-up runs automatically.

The stairs-improvement and stall blocks are dropped as in g3_guard_push4_v1, because this run targets G3 and only protects the stairs. Earlier editions keep their code path, so every stored verdict is reproduced byte for byte.
plan_screening.combination: artifact/fingerprint validity first; fact_rules_v1 AND g3_guard_margin_v1; missing data overrides performance as INCONCLUSIVE
plan_screening.partial_coverage: Any missing environment or missing protection case makes screening INCONCLUSIVE; keep valid observations without promotion.
plan_screening.known_properties: the protection block is post_a048_guard_margin_v1's, so conditional on the stored G-A033 sample: 0.519 false-failure rate for a candidate from the same empirical distribution, 0.035 mean miss rate over the defined harms. Not a server re-run error rate. The edition was chosen after G-A048 was observed.

preregistered.rule_source: reports/GO2_STAIRS_BEHAVIOR_ANALYSIS_20260916.md 8-3b (target G3 G5, guard G1 G2 G4 G6 G7) and 8-4 (stairs measured by climbed robots); gap found by reports/GO2_G_A038_READOUT.md section 4

climb_guard.omitted: stairs_15_climb_ge1 is left out on purpose. Its baseline sum is 4 robots over three seeds and its measured max_drop is 5.523, so its floor is -1.523 and no result can violate it. tools/go2_fact_rules.py calls that inoperable and raises it as a violation rather than passing it silently (defect S-2, 2026-09-19). The 15 cm climb is still measured in stage 1 as a required record and judged by the local plan screening, which compares the pooled counts and the per-seed progress directly; it is not a gate here because at this sample size it cannot be one.

hypothesis.statement: On G-A048's rewards, ang_vel_xy_l2 -0.06 lowers rough side-step posture falls below G-A048's 16 by at least half; whether the G2 combined-turn posture cost appears is recorded. The stairs are judged as adoption protection and counted here without a verdict.

rough_lateral_posture_falls.basis: G-A048 fell 16 of 96 (5 / 8 / 3). 8 is half-way between G-A048 and zero - the same operational rule as the 41 of G-A048..G-A050 (half-way between 59 and 24). It is not a statistical or official criterion and changes no adoption threshold. 16 or more means no reduction against G-A048.

yaw_right_posture_cost.basis: G-A043 fell at all three seeds (9, 9, 11); G-A048 at none. One seed only is INSUFFICIENT.

hypothesis.edge_rule: Avoiding falsification is not support. 9 to 15 rough side-step falls is INSUFFICIENT and is reported as 'reduced, below the target of 8', not as 'no improvement'. The 8 is an operational target (a 50 percent cut), not a statistical significance criterion.
decisions: REVIEW_CANDIDATE (reward_base_comparison): quantitative review candidate only - a person reads every A048-relative protection delta, the videos and the self-assessment before anything is called progress; the training-seed replicate waits on U2; no automatic long training.

QUANT_SUCCESS_VIDEO_REVIEW_PENDING against G-A033 but NOT_REVIEW_CANDIDATE: report 'meets the G-A033 quantitative conditions, not better than G-A048'; not tuning progress. The next candidate on G-A048's rewards is re-compared by the failed item.
rough 9-15 (INSUFFICIENT): 'reduced, below target' - no candidate review, no automatic -0.055 / -0.065 follow-up; the next choice uses the size of the reduction and its costs.
protection failure against G-A033, or rough NOT_SUPPORTED (16 or more): reject. No -0.055 / -0.065 automatic follow-up.
yaw cost PRESENT: record it next to the verdicts; fact_rules_v1's flat guard judges its score effect.
missing or invalid artifacts: no performance conclusion; recover what is recoverable.

stairs_10_ge2.basis: recorded, not judged: G-A048 90 of 96, G-A038 0. The stairs are judged as protection cases by g3_guard_margin_v1.

reward_base_comparison.verdicts: REVIEW_CANDIDATE (all four requirements; a quantitative review candidate, not final progress) / NOT_REVIEW_CANDIDATE (lists the failed ones) / INCONCLUSIVE (unverified harvest or missing data)

min_speed.basis: A preregistered floor on the rough side-step speed magnitude (seed mean): G-A048's lowest seed (0.183 / 0.164 / 0.174 m/s, mean about 0.174). Meeting it does NOT show the policy did not slow down - 0.164 is still slower than G-A048's mean - and speed is a magnitude, so it does not show correct side-stepping either. It is an auxiliary condition that caps a large slow-down and is read together with the tracking RMSE and progress of the same case. G-A038's seeds (0.162 / 0.159 / 0.149) sit below it.

reward_base_comparison.not_judged: A048-relative losses on the protected cases (stairs both heights, pushes four ways, combined turns) have no preregistered limit in this run. They are disclosed by the reader and judged by a person at review; no limit is invented after the result.

why: Purpose: cut G3 rough side-step rollovers on G-A048's rewards while keeping G-A048's gains (total 50.16, rough falls 16, 10 cm ge2 90, combined-turn falls 0, push falls 1). Not a promise of a higher score.
Support: G-A038 (-0.05 -> -0.08 on G-A033) cut rough side-step falls 59 -> 18 and raised its 9-case target proxy by 0.088.

Against: the same run collapsed the 10 cm climb (96 falls) and slowed rough side-stepping; both results come with a terrain-level difference at iteration 900 (G-A033 4.4937, G-A038 1.9499) that the reward change itself may have caused; the total results are observed but the direct mechanism is not separated. The step is a third of G-A038's.
Selection by Codex (relayed by the user); package and records by the main loop.

ang_vel_xy_l2.role: Penalize xy-axis base angular velocity using L2 squared kernel. [isaaclab_envs_mdp_rewards.py:83]
ang_vel_xy_l2.out_of_range_reason: Only -0.05 is a walking value in the base table: G-A038 (-0.08) and G-A041 (-0.04) measured target cases only and are partial rows. -0.06 is chosen as a limited step toward G-A038's rough gain; it is exploratory, not an interpolation.

lin_vel_z_l2.role: Penalize z-axis base linear velocity using L2 squared kernel. [isaaclab_envs_mdp_rewards.py:76]

walk_margin.reason: The push cell is slightly negative (-0.0067) while walk, climb and sway are positive. The sheet's cells got directions wrong on this baseline before (G-A047), so the push protection block, not this cell, judges push.

inference.rule: fact-based inference chain (2026-09-17 user instruction; MASTER section 5, AGENTS 4-9); a point-gain estimate is not required
inference.role: Isaac Lab v2.3.1 ang_vel_xy_l2 (reports/evidence/go2_reward_term_roles_20260917/isaaclab_envs_mdp_rewards.py:83) pays -w * (omega_x^2 + omega_y^2) of the body-frame angular velocity. It charges roll/pitch rate, not tilt and not a fall; the link to rollovers is G-A038's observation, not the formula.

rows.reads: the run the support comes from: G-A038 trained ang_vel_xy_l2 -0.08 on G-A033's other weights, measured with the same instrument (posture_gate_v2) and walked (POLICY_LOCOMOTES).
G-A038 (-0.08 on G-A033) rough side-step falls per seed 4 / 8 / 6 = 18 against G-A033's 20 / 20 / 19 = 59.
the G-A033 counterpart of the row above.
G-A048's residual rough side-step falls are mostly terminated only (2 / 6 / 2 = 10 of 16): the rollover share this change targets.

contradicting.reads: the same G-A038 run collapsed the 10 cm climb: 32 posture falls of 32 at every seed, survival 0.
and slowed rough side-stepping: 0.162 / 0.159 / 0.149 m/s against G-A033's 0.200 / 0.195 / 0.190.

terrain level at iteration 900 was G-A033 4.4937 against G-A038 1.9499 (reports/GO2_G_A038_READOUT.md), the reward change may itself have caused that difference, so the direct mechanism of both G-A038 results is not separated.

inference.singularity: One strengthening point on another reward base cut rough side-step falls to a third while collapsing the 10 cm climb, with a terrain-level difference at iteration 900 (G-A033 4.4937, G-A038 1.9499) that the reward change itself may have caused; the total results are observed but the direct mechanism is not separated. G-A048 already sits below G-A038's rough falls (16 against 18), bound by rollovers.

walk.basis: spec_margin for the candidate rewards: walk margin +0.133, zone WALK, about eight times the stop zone's top. No walking change is claimed.

climb.basis: G-A038 collapsed the 10 cm climb at a much larger step, with a terrain-level difference at iteration 900 (G-A033 4.4937, G-A038 1.9499) that the reward change itself may have caused; the total results are observed but the direct mechanism is not separated; no direction is claimed at -0.06. Judged by the stairs protection checks.

sway.basis: the hypothesis: rough side-step falls fall below G-A048's 16 (supported at 8 or fewer). Exploratory, from G-A038 only.

push.basis: G-A048 lost 1 robot over four directions; no direction is claimed. All four directions are protected.

inference.falsified_if: Hypothesis (tools/go2_dial_hypothesis.py): not supported if rough side-step posture falls are 16 or more of 96; 9-15 is INSUFFICIENT ('reduced, below target'). A quantitative review candidate (tools/go2_reward_base_comparison.py) additionally needs QUANT_SUCCESS_VIDEO_REVIEW_PENDING against G-A033, a total not below G-A048 and a rough side-step speed of at least 0.164 m/s; it is not a final progress verdict.
inference.seed_limit: Every training run used seed 42 and no seed replicate exists, so a result supports or refutes the exploratory hypothesis at this value on this path; it does not generalize.
inference.status_reason: INFORMATION_RUN: the only prior is G-A038 on another reward base with its own cost and a terrain-level difference at iteration 900 (G-A033 4.4937, G-A038 1.9499) that the reward change itself may have caused; the total results are observed but the direct mechanism is not separated, so no improvement is predicted; the run answers whether part of that rough gain appears on G-A048's rewards at a third of the step.
inference.counterevidence_response: The adverse rows change the design: G-A038's climb collapse limits the step to a third and keeps both stair heights as protection; its slower side-stepping becomes an auxiliary speed floor read with tracking and progress; its terrain difference becomes a required record, read as part of the total result because the reward change may have caused it.

reward_base.name: G-A048
reward_base.why: Codex selected G-A048's reward setting as the promising base (50.15655/70 against G-A033's 42.52861) and asked for one change on it. G-A048's own adoption failed on its screening edition; it is a reward base, not an adopted baseline.
